from itertools import combinations
from math import sqrt
population=[0,0,1,1]; N=len(population); t=2; true=sum(population)/N
hits=[]
for selection in combinations(population,t):
    p=sum(selection)/t
    half=sqrt(p*(1-p)/t*(N-t)/(N-1))
    hits.append(p-half<=true<=p+half)
print('exact coverage of printed plus/minus interval:',sum(hits),'/',len(hits))
for requested in [0,1,2,5]:
    fewshots=0; kept=[]
    for subject in ['a','b','a','a']:
        if fewshots==requested: break
        if subject!='a': continue
        kept.append(subject)
    print('requested, included:',requested,len(kept))
